title: Hyperion Mod
description: This project recreates hyperion from hypixel skyblock but with more bugs :3
body:
This mod recreates the hyperion item from hypixel skyblock. Currently the only way to obtain it is to do /give but I'm planning to add a recipe so that it's still balanced for late game singleplayer. Also the melee damage is bugged. Right click ability: Teleports 10 blocks forward, then implodes and deals 30 dmg to enemies around you, also gives the player absorption 4 and resistance 1 for 5 seconds.

Also placeholder texture from bedless 550k
